title: Saka 7+ points, GW6
rules:
Resolves YES if the official Fantasy Premier League site credits Bukayo Saka with 7 or more points for Gameweek 6, once every match in that gameweek is marked finished and bonus points are final. Resolves NO otherwise.

Sources: https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/bootstrap-static/, https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/event/6/live/

admission.note: Requires Moxie market admission and local liquidity before trading is enabled.
